name: Can A Pastor Divorce And Remarry
overview: Scripture clearly upholds the sanctity and permanence of marriage, emphasizing that God hates divorce as a betrayal of His covenant (Malachi 2:16). Jesus teaches in Matthew and Mark that divorcing one's spouse and remarrying, except in cases of sexual immorality, constitutes adultery (Matthew 5:31-32; 19:9; Mark 10:11). Marriage was established by God from the beginning as a lifelong union between male and female (Matthew 19:4), underscoring the serious responsibility pastors carry to honor this divine design in their own lives.
